data.gender_notes: Anukul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anukul means friendly, pleasing, or favorable. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anukoola' which means 'towards what is pleasing'. In Hindu mythology, Anukul is a name for Lord Vishnu and is associated with compassion and love. The name Anukul carries the meaning “Friendly, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anukul usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anukul total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Anukulchudamani was a great Chola king who ruled from 1182 to 1216 CE. He was a powerful ruler and defeated the invading forces of the Chalukyas and the Pandyas. Anukulchudamani was a great patron of arts and literature and built several temples during his reign.

Anandakumara Anukul Shastri was an influential Hindu philosopher and scholar who lived during the 17th and 18th centuries. He was a leading exponent of the Advaita Vedanta philosophy and wrote several commentaries on the works of Shankara. Anukul Shastri was also a prolific poet and wrote extensively on various themes in Sanskrit literature.
